title: Chapter 113 Counterattack
content:
Chapter 113 Counterattack

"Since I'm in a good mood, I'll tell you!"

"Because you killed Wen Tai, he is one of my descendants." Brunei said casually.

In fact, this is just an excuse he made. If he hadn't investigated, he wouldn't have known that he had a descendant named Wen Tai.

The real reason is that he got the promise from the Iron Lord.

He couldn't say this.

Wang Shuo stood there, motionless, thinking about countermeasures quickly in his mind.

How can I let the toad swallow me into his mouth?

Suddenly, the toad's eyelids jumped, his eyes suddenly became sharp, and a cold light shot out from his eyeballs as big as a millstone.

"Okay, since I've said it, then you will be my food obediently!"

As soon as the voice fell, he immediately stretched out his tongue and rolled Wang Shuo into his mouth.

Toad Brunei, seemingly lazy, is actually vigorous and resolute.

Either don't do it, or strike decisively.

This is an important reason why he can stand out from many small toads and grow into a golden boss.

Watching Wang Shuo being swept away by the giant tongue.

Before everyone could react, Wang Shuo entered the giant mouth of the toad.

Suddenly, everyone exclaimed!

"Lord!"

There were even some extremely loyal subjects who had completely recognized Wang Shuo.

At this time, tears flashed in their eyes and they covered their faces with tears.

Gong Zheng and others were even more grief-stricken.

Just when everyone was immersed in grief, thinking that they would be the next to be swallowed.

"Bang."

"Bang."

"Bang."

...

The continuous explosions resounded through the world.

Gong Zheng and Ayub, who were closer to the toad, were directly rushed dozens of meters away by the powerful explosion.

Fortunately, they both had golden armor, which saved their lives.

Most of the beast corpses in the distance were affected by the explosion and vaporized instantly, leaving no energy crystals.

The few remaining broken walls and ruins in Wana Village were also destroyed.

Only one territory core was left, because it was hundreds of meters away from the center of the explosion, and after integrating the bronze village building order, its durability had reached 10,000 points, so it was preserved.

As for the other residents, since everyone's level had reached above level 10, their health points had also been greatly improved.

But at this time, almost all of them were left with residual blood. Before the explosion, several residents with lower health points also received boxed lunches directly.

Among them was Wang Shuo's maid Xiaona.

When everyone came to their senses.

Only to see that the toad had been blown to pieces at this time, and the explosion in the body was still continuing.

"No!"

...

...

Desperate howling!

Coming from the center of the explosion, the sound shook the four fields!

"Bang!!!"

Another earth-shattering noise.

Toad Brunei could no longer hold his body.

Completely blown to pieces.

The broken limbs and flesh were scattered all over.

A huge cloud of dust was left at the original place.

Xu Qing and the others were shocked when they saw it, their mouths opened wide, as if they could swallow an egg.

They saw with their own eyes that Wang Shuo was sucked into the mouth, and then the toad exploded.

Seeing such a tragic ending, Zhang Jinsheng shook his head, sighed and said, "Let's go!"

The power of this explosion was not as strong as the first one.

So the people nearby were not hurt.

After the explosion, the surroundings fell into a strange silence!

"What did the lord do?"

"Is the lord dead?"

...

Countless questions popped up in everyone's mind.
